Physics · Mathematical Physics · Computational Physics

I'm an undergraduate physics student at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. My interests are in mathematical and computational physics — particularly Hamiltonian mechanics, structure-preserving numerical methods, and plasma physics. This site collects notes, code, and the occasional video as I work through them: research interests, projects, notes, and videos.
